name: Vanessa Zee
bio: Vanessa Fritzie Ulina Simorangkir, better known as Vanessa Zee (born February 15, 2004), is an Indonesian singer. Vanessa was a top-four finalist in the thirteenth season of Indonesian Idol in 2025, which was broadcast on RCTI. Previously, she also placed third in the third season of The Voice Kids Indonesia in 2018, which was broadcast on GTV.

credits.title: Coming Home
credits.overview: A prominent young professional residing in Jakarta is abruptly recalled to his ancestral North Sumatra homeland by his patriarch to campaign for public office, where his political ambitions intersect with a transformative romantic awakening centered on the Batak customs he long neglected.
